title: Rewrite
text: Multiply the top and bottom by $$e^{2t}$$ to get $$\frac{e^{2t}}{\left(e^{2t}-1\right)^2}$$.

title: Substitute
text: Let $$u=e^{2t}$$, so $$du=2e^{2t} dt$$. The integral becomes $$\frac{1}{2}$$ times the integral of $$\frac{1}{\left(u-1\right)^2}$$, which is $$\frac{-1}{2\left(u-1\right)}$$.
